headline: CBA Shares Fall 9.93% in August as Valuation Reset Overshadows Record Profit - The Bull
summary: Commonwealth Bank of Australia shares fell 9.93% in August as record annual profits collided with regulatory card-fee changes and renewed interest-rate uncertainty. A late-month bounce partly recovered the losses.
why: Commonwealth Bank is Australia's largest bank by market value, so its share moves influence the ASX and the country's financial sector.
